fusions.name: Sudden Jaws
fusions.desc: You clamp down on the target for 30 damage. The hit is always a critical hit, and it leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 10% of health the target still has (max 30%).

fusions.name: Reopened
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: a tearing weapon strike for 9 damage that leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Log in the Shallows
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Banked Patience
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. You have 25% more critical chance against enemies that have not been hurt yet.
